papers.title: SceneFun3D

papers.title: BEHAVIOR-1K

papers.project_relevance: Provides concrete fields for MaterialField, ExternalForce, DynamicResponse, and DeformableState validators.

papers.title: Feature Splatting
papers.data: 3D Gaussian scenes with distilled foundation-model features, text-grounded decomposition, material queries, and physics-simulation examples

papers.project_relevance: Useful for SceneRepresentation, MaterialProperty, SegmentByText, PhysicsEdit, and simulator-backed validation.

papers.title: PhysX-Anything

papers.title: SimuScene
papers.data: single-image compositional 3D scene reconstruction benchmarks plus humanoid and robot-arm downstream deployments

papers.title: REST3D
papers.data: synthetic and real-world single-RGB-image reconstruction datasets, Isaac Gym simulation checks, and VR interaction demos

papers.project_relevance: Provides a useful template for SceneTree, SupportGraph, StabilityCheck, and PhysicsRefinement stages.

papers.title: TriSplat
papers.data: RealEstate10K, DL3DV, ScanNet-style sparse-view reconstruction evaluations

papers.project_relevance: Useful representation reference for MeshScene, CollisionSurface, and feed-forward sim-ready reconstruction.

papers.title: SceneCode: Editable Indoor Scene Generation using Executable World Programs
papers.data: indoor scene layouts and hierarchical scene-program examples covering generation, reconstruction, and editing

papers.task: generate, reconstruct, and edit indoor scenes through executable world programs
papers.novelty: treats indoor scene generation as structured executable program synthesis rather than opaque scene decoding
papers.project_relevance: Strong representation reference for structured world code, room-level decomposition, and local indoor-scene edits.

papers.title: WonderPlay: Dynamic 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image and Actions
papers.data: single-image action examples spanning rigid, elastic, cloth, smoke, liquid and granular materials
papers.method: Gaussian-surfels reconstruction, material-specific physics solvers, video generation and differentiable 3D state refinement
papers.task: generate action-conditioned dynamic 3D scenes across material types
papers.novelty: closes the loop between explicit coarse multi-material physics and generative video refinement
papers.project_relevance: Executable-world reference for typed materials, forces and hybrid simulated/generated state.

papers.title: FAMOS: Feed-Forward 3D Articulation Modeling from Sparse Observations
papers.data: PartNet-Mobility, ACD, ArtiCraft-10K, and procedurally generated articulated assets.
papers.method: Multi-state articulation transformer with motion-span supervision.
papers.task: Infer movable parts and executable joints from sparse unordered point clouds.
papers.novelty: Feed-forward variable-view articulation recovery across observed states.
papers.project_relevance: MovablePart, JointAxis, JointOrigin, MotionRange, and multi-state evidence fields.

papers.title: FunArt: Decoding Functional Structure and Articulation from Generative 3D Latents
papers.data: Articulate3D posed RGB-D observations.
papers.method: Frozen TRELLIS.2 O-Voxel prior plus a joint functional/articulation decoder.
papers.task: Construct articulation-aware functional 3D scene graphs.
papers.novelty: Decodes actionable function and kinematics jointly from generative 3D latents.
papers.project_relevance: FunctionalElement, MovablePart, JointType, Axis, Origin, and Range fields.

papers.title: PointCast: One World Model for Rigid, Articulated, and Deformable Object Manipulation
papers.data: Randomized rigid, cloth, rope, and cabinet simulation plus real teleoperation data.
papers.method: Identity-preserving point-set diffusion dynamics conditioned on end-effector motion.
papers.task: Predict object dynamics and support model-predictive manipulation control.
papers.novelty: One mesh-free topology-agnostic representation spans rigid, articulated, and deformable objects.
papers.project_relevance: PointIdentity, ObjectState, EndEffectorMotion, PredictedTrajectory, and topology-regime fields.

papers.title: PhysLDM: Latent Diffusion for High-Fidelity Deformable Simulation
papers.data: Objaverse-scale kinematic volumetric-mesh trajectories, with OOD evaluation on GSO and Toys4K.
papers.method: A holistic spatiotemporal VAE compresses high-resolution volumetric trajectories, followed by latent diffusion for one-shot deformable dynamics prediction.
papers.task: Predict long-horizon, high-resolution deformable-body trajectories and support differentiable inverse/design optimization.
papers.novelty: Introduces a compact spatiotemporal latent-diffusion formulation for volumetric deformable simulation and shows diffusion avoids non-physical regression averages in chaotic regimes.
papers.project_relevance: Directly informs DeformableState, VolumetricMesh, MaterialDynamics, BoundaryCondition, and differentiable simulator interfaces.

papers.title: RoboSimStudio: An Interactive Toolkit for Human and Agent Rapid Real2Sim of Robot Manipulation Tasks
papers.data: Observed real robot interactions, editable Newton simulations, visual and force-feedback traces, and agentic Real2Sim2Real case studies.

papers.task: Rapidly build and calibrate manipulation simulations from observed physical behavior.
papers.novelty: Makes contact modeling and physical parameter revision explicit, editable, and agent-operable rather than hiding them in a one-shot real-to-sim pipeline.
papers.project_relevance: Directly informs editable PhysicsConfig, ContactModel, ForceTrace, SimCalibration, and Real2Sim2Real validation fields.

papers.title: AutoRSR: Automated Real-to-Sim-to-Real Data Generation for Scalable Robot Learning
papers.data: Multi-view workspace observations, robot states, open-vocabulary queries, reference motions, and 1K generated episodes per task across three real tasks.
papers.method: Reconstructs metric workspaces, extracts object assets, registers scenes to the robot frame, and scales reference motions with interpolation and domain randomization.
papers.task: Convert scanned real workspaces into executable simulation assets and transferable manipulation data.
papers.novelty: Automates object extraction, metric scene registration, trajectory generation, and sim-to-real data scaling in one pipeline.
papers.project_relevance: Useful for MetricScene, RobotFrameRegistration, ExecutableAsset, ReferenceMotion, and sim-to-real dataset contracts.

papers.title: PhyScene
papers.data: 3D scene layouts, 3D-FRONT / ProcTHOR conditions, articulated GAPartNet assets, and Isaac Sim interaction examples
papers.method: conditional diffusion scene layout generation guided by collision, room-layout, and reachability/interactivity constraints
papers.task: synthesize physically plausible and interactable 3D indoor scenes for embodied agents
papers.novelty: adds physical and agent-interaction guidance to scene synthesis rather than optimizing only visual/layout naturalness
papers.project_relevance: Baseline for InteractionConstraint, Reachability, Collision, Articulation, and GeneratedScene validity metrics.

papers.title: RoboGen

papers.title: Steerable Scene Generation

papers.title: SAGE

papers.title: EmbodiedGen

papers.method: generative 3D world engine for embodied intelligence

papers.title: Holodeck

papers.title: Infinigen Indoors
papers.data: fully procedural indoor scenes, furniture, architecture elements, appliances, and dense synthetic labels from Blender

papers.project_relevance: Strong generator for Scene, Asset, Annotation, LayoutConstraint, and synthetic data pipelines.

papers.title: SceneSmith

papers.project_relevance: Top PCG baseline for PromptToScene, CriticLoop, ObjectPopulation, PhysicalProperty, and policy evaluation.

papers.title: SceneFoundry
papers.data: apartment-scale generated 3D worlds with articulated assets from large-scale repositories
papers.method: language-guided diffusion with LLM floor-plan control, posterior sampling for object population, articulation-collision and walkability guidance
papers.task: generate large-scale interactive and physically usable indoor 3D worlds
papers.novelty: focuses on functionally articulated furniture and apartment-scale interactive world generation
papers.project_relevance: Relevant PCG line for LayoutConstraint, ArticulationConstraint, WalkableSpace, and infinite-world expansion.

papers.title: HY-World 2.0
papers.data: text, single-view, multi-view, and video inputs; generated 3DGS/mesh worlds; released model weights and code
papers.method: four-stage world pipeline with panorama generation, trajectory planning, world expansion, reconstruction, and WorldLens rendering
papers.task: reconstruct, generate, and simulate navigable 3D worlds from multimodal inputs
papers.novelty: unifies generation and reconstruction for explorable 3D worlds with open weights/code
papers.project_relevance: Strong open-source world-generation baseline for WorldRepresentation, TrajectoryPlan, 3DGSScene, MeshExport, and engine integration.

papers.title: SimWorld Studio: Generation and Evolution of Custom Embodied Agent Learning Environments
papers.data: benchmark suite with 320 embodied tasks and 240 held-out layouts plus generated and evolved environment examples
papers.method: environment generation-and-evolution loop that refines embodied learning worlds from user goals and feedback
papers.task: generate and iteratively evolve custom embodied learning environments
papers.novelty: extends embodied environment generation into an explicit closed-loop evolution process rather than one-shot PCG output
papers.project_relevance: Strong PCG baseline for custom embodied worlds, curriculum generation, and iterative environment refinement.

papers.title: EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI
papers.data: sim-ready asset, scene, and task-world generation pipeline with public Hugging Face collection and dataset for cross-simulator embodied world construction.

papers.task: turn text, images, and dialogue instructions into executable multi-room 3D worlds that can be deployed across major simulators for embodied learning.
papers.novelty: pushes embodied world generation from isolated assets toward a reusable, agentic world engine that keeps affordances, state, layout stability, and simulator interfaces aligned.
papers.project_relevance: Very strong fit for the repository’s interactive generation branch because it connects asset generation, affordance/state retention, and executable world assembly.

papers.title: Image2Sim: Scaling Embodied Navigation via Generative Neural Simulator
papers.data: Nearly 20K interactive scenes and more than 10M generated navigation samples from posed RGB-D imagery.
papers.method: Feature-Gaussian anchoring plus geometry-aware one-step panoramic RGB-D rendering, motion simulation, and automatic action/instruction annotation.
papers.task: Build real-time interactive neural navigation environments and scalable training data from captured imagery.
papers.novelty: Decouples 3D spatial anchoring from photorealistic observation synthesis to turn image collections into executable simulators.
papers.project_relevance: Direct baseline for image-to-interactive-world generation, navigability, and action-aligned data creation.

papers.title: WonderWorld: Interactive 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image
papers.data: single images with user camera/content controls across natural and built environments
papers.method: Fast Layered Gaussian Surfels, text outpainting and guided depth diffusion
papers.task: incrementally generate connected user-steered 3D worlds
papers.novelty: low-latency connected 3D scene expansion under online camera and content control
papers.project_relevance: Direct baseline for interactive world building and latency-aware PCG.

papers.title: SpatialCrafter: Single Image World Modeling with Generative 3D Proxies
papers.data: Single-image indoor/outdoor scenes, camera trajectories, and long-video evaluations shown on the official project page.
papers.method: Point-anchored Sparse Structure Flow generates a global 3D proxy, followed by proxy-conditioned video diffusion appearance refinement.
papers.task: Generate controllable, explorable, long-horizon scene videos from a single image.
papers.novelty: Uses a generative global 3D proxy as persistent structure and spatial memory to reduce drift during chunked exploration.
papers.project_relevance: Strong reference for persistent 3D memory, controllable camera trajectories, and structure/appearance separation in interactive generation.

papers.title: Gamma-World: Generative Multi-Agent World Modeling Beyond Two Players
papers.data: Synchronized multi-agent gameplay and real multi-robot sequences with released training and inference workflows.
papers.method: Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding, Sparse Hub Attention, and bidirectional-teacher to block-causal-student distillation with KV caching.
papers.task: Generate one coherent, action-responsive video world for multiple independently controlled agents.
papers.novelty: Extends interactive video world models beyond one action stream with permutation-equivalent agent identity, linear-cost cross-agent communication, and real-time rollout.
papers.project_relevance: Direct architecture and evaluation reference for synchronized multi-agent generation, action streams, and shared-world consistency.

papers.title: Astronex-World 1.0: Real-Time Interactive World Model Foundation
papers.data: Mixed controllable video domains with released training assets and weights.
papers.method: Pose-aware bidirectional and block-causal video models with action conditioning and distillation.
papers.task: Generate persistent video under camera, action, embodiment, and event control.
papers.novelty: Open full-context and real-time causal streaming in one world-model family.
papers.project_relevance: Baseline for real-time world generation and action/camera/event interfaces.

papers.title: AgriGen: Large-Scale Scene Generation Framework for Photorealistic Agricultural Robotics Simulation
papers.data: Procedural row-crop, orchard, and vineyard environments with layout and lighting variation.
papers.method: ROS-integrated Isaac Sim scene generation with physics and domain randomization.
papers.task: Generate scalable agricultural simulation worlds for robot learning and evaluation.
papers.novelty: Packages agricultural morphology and seasonal/layout variation into a controllable robotics PCG interface.
papers.project_relevance: CropType, RowCurve, PlantSpacing, Lighting, PhysicsConfig, and randomization fields.

papers.title: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation
papers.data: Short real-world videos converted into digital twins plus object, scene, and task digital cousins across seven manipulation tasks and five policy architectures.
papers.method: A modular extraction-generation-augmentation pipeline segments a video, reconstructs objects and background, estimates physics and articulation, compiles an OmniGibson scene, and generates affordance-preserving cousins.
papers.task: Automatically build editable simulation-ready scenes for robot-policy training and evaluation from real video.
papers.novelty: Connects automated real-to-sim reconstruction with systematic digital-cousin generation and validates both policy ranking and zero-shot real transfer.

papers.title: WorldCast: Distributed Multiplayer World Models
papers.data: Counter-Strike 2 multi-player trajectories with player positions, map geometry, controls, and synchronized views.
papers.method: Each player runs a local video-generator/state-model client; clients exchange compact player and scene states projected into camera-aligned fields.
papers.task: Generate independently controlled, mutually consistent multiplayer views in real time.
papers.novelty: Replaces costly joint multi-view generation with distributed local world-model clients coordinated through compact shared state.
papers.project_relevance: Useful for SharedWorldState, PlayerState, CrossViewConsistency, ConcurrentAction, and distributed interactive-world runtime contracts.

papers.title: Tetris3D: 3D Scene Generation With Objects That Fit Together
papers.data: ComOb, a physics-simulation dataset of 1.2M scenes with per-object meshes and pairwise physical-relation annotations.
papers.method: Generates each scene object conditioned on surrounding geometry and physical relations so shape and pose remain compatible at occluded interaction regions.
papers.task: Reconstruct physically and geometrically coherent object-level 3D scenes from a single image.
papers.novelty: Makes local inter-object fit an explicit generation condition rather than generating scene objects independently.
papers.project_relevance: Direct reference for ContactRelation, Support, FitConstraint, OccludedGeometry, PhysicalStability, and scene-assembly validators.

papers.title: PhySGA: A Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for Generalizable and Interactive 3D Composition
papers.data: Isaac Sim composition tasks spanning rigid, articulated, and deformable objects with hanging, settling, alignment, and containment relations.

papers.task: Interactively assemble physically plausible 3D object compositions in simulation.
papers.novelty: Grounds agentic 3D composition in closed-loop contact dynamics and executable simulator actions rather than static coordinate prediction.
papers.project_relevance: Direct reference for AssemblyPlan, ContactDiagnosis, ActionPrimitive, SkillLibrary, PhysicalRelation, and scene validators.

papers.title: From Failures to Learnable Worlds: Policy-Conditioned Environment Generation for Navigation Agents

papers.project_relevance: Useful for FailureFeature, EnvironmentFactor, GeneratorControl, DiagnosticSplit, and targeted curriculum generation.

papers.title: PAWA: Panoramic Action-conditioned World Modeling for Multiple Agents
papers.data: Synchronized Minecraft player POV videos, world-stabilized panoramic videos, and aligned actions, captured with a pipeline scaling beyond 64 players.

papers.task: Predict action-conditioned shared-world evolution for multiple independently acting players.

papers.title: RoboTwin-Phys: Do WAMs and VLAs Understand the Physical World?
papers.data: More than 5,000 demonstrations with ground-truth values for 13 physical attributes.
papers.method: Continuous plausible mass, friction, joint-dynamics, and related physics variation.
papers.task: Evaluate WAM/VLA robustness to physical-condition shifts.
papers.novelty: Makes physical parameters a first-class benchmark axis beyond visual/layout randomization.
papers.project_relevance: Mass, Friction, JointDynamics, PhysicalCondition, and robustness fields.

papers.title: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics
papers.data: Open synchronized medical-robot video and kinematics from 49+ institutions and multiple platforms across surgery, ultrasound, and endoscopy.
papers.method: A cross-institution, multi-embodiment data standard plus GR00T-H VLA and Cosmos-H action-conditioned surgical world-model baselines.
papers.task: Train and evaluate medical robot foundation models, action prediction, and multi-embodiment surgical simulation.
papers.novelty: Provides the largest reported open synchronized medical-robot corpus and demonstrates both a VLA and one-checkpoint multi-platform world model on it.
papers.project_relevance: Extends embodied data infrastructure with synchronized video-kinematics, clinical embodiment metadata, multi-platform action schemas, and long-horizon procedure evaluation.

papers.title: LIVIN: Benchmarking Spatial and Embodied Intelligence in Digital Twins of Lived-In Homes
papers.data: Digital twins of 30 diverse lived-in homes preserving layouts, furniture, belongings, and constrained interaction regions.
papers.method: Human-in-the-loop instance recognition, architectural reconstruction, object generation, and placement, with review against source observations.
papers.task: Evaluate 3D detection, reconstruction, navigation, and loco-manipulation in realistic lived-in homes.
papers.novelty: Combines real-home correspondence, interaction readiness, and dense lived-in arrangements in one digital-twin benchmark.
papers.project_relevance: Direct infrastructure for HomeTwin, ObjectArrangement, FreeSpace, InteractionRegion, Reconstruction, Navigation, and LocoManipulation schemas.

papers.title: MultiWorldBench: Do Independently Controlled Views Describe One Shared World?
papers.data: 495 Minecraft case configurations across seven suites and ten multiplayer world-consistency capabilities.
papers.method: Diagnostic automatic and human evaluation of control, cross-view motion, shared state, persistence, concurrency, delayed revisit, and structure.
papers.task: Measure whether independently controlled generated views remain one coherent shared world.
papers.novelty: Separates plausible single views from persistent multi-client world consistency with capability-level diagnostics.
papers.project_relevance: Essential evaluation layer for SharedState, Persistence, ConcurrentInteraction, CrossViewMotion, DelayedRevisit, and StructuralConsistency.

papers.title: OpenViTac: Learning and Benchmarking Visuo-Tactile Policies in a Unified Sim-and-Real Framework
papers.data: 11 simulation tasks, eight paired real tasks, four tactile capabilities, and three tactile-sensor types.
papers.method: A paired sim-real benchmark plus OpenVTLA, which prepends temporally encoded tactile tokens to a pretrained VLA visual sequence.
papers.task: Evaluate and train VLA, WAM, and VTLA policies on contact-rich manipulation in simulation and reality.
papers.novelty: Provides aligned sim-real tactile tasks and controlled comparisons of tactile representations, fusion, and co-training.
papers.project_relevance: Direct source for TactileHistory, PhysicalProperty, SensorType, SimRealPair, ContactTask, and cross-domain evaluation.

papers.title: RT-Safe: Benchmarking Agent Safety in Real-Time Embodied Environment
papers.data: Simulated urban navigation tasks with moving actors, hazards, traffic rules, and worlds that evolve during inference.
papers.method: Matched static and real-time evaluation explicitly measures both decision safety and latency-induced risk; the benchmark also supports offline RL.
papers.task: Evaluate embodied-agent safety when the physical world continues changing during reasoning and execution.
papers.novelty: Makes inference latency itself part of the embodied safety environment instead of freezing the world at observation time.
papers.project_relevance: Adds ObservationTime, DecisionLatency, ExecutionTime, DynamicHazard, CollisionEvent, and SafeCompletion fields.

papers.title: The Robot Is Not Its Description: GaugeBench for Representation Robustness in Morphology-Aware Policies
papers.data: Physically equivalent rewrites of 80 familiar and 98 held-out robot mechanisms across MetaMorph, ModuMorph, and PyBullet.
papers.method: Rewrites axis direction, angle zero, link/joint ordering, and coordinates while verifying the physical mechanism and policy interface remain equivalent.
papers.task: Test whether morphology-aware policies preserve behavior under equivalent robot-description conventions.
papers.novelty: Separates embodiment generalization from arbitrary representation-gauge robustness.
papers.project_relevance: Direct validator for EmbodimentDescription, JointAxis, CoordinateConvention, LinkOrder, ActionTransport, and invariance tests.

papers.title: BiGym 2.0: Benchmarking Learned and Agent-Developed Policies for Humanoid Household Manipulation
papers.data: 20 Unitree G1 household tasks, 60 VR demonstrations per task, 1,200 demonstrations, and 5,400 coding-agent evaluation episodes.
papers.method: A common whole-body controller and observation/action interface compare VLA fine-tuning, imitation, demo-driven RL, and code-writing agents under fixed seeds.
papers.task: Benchmark learned and agent-authored humanoid household manipulation policies.
papers.novelty: Places coding-agent policies and learned humanoid controllers in the same open, replayable evaluation harness.
papers.project_relevance: Strong infrastructure for WholeBodyController, VRDemonstration, HiddenSeed, AgentWrittenPolicy, ReplayTrace, and humanoid task evaluation.

papers.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
papers.data: 312 tasks in five suites, 37 single and 18 paired preferences, and 40.8K demonstrations with task, preference, simulator-state, and per-step metadata.
papers.method: A procedural LIBERO pipeline generates preference-ready scenes, paired preferred/non-preferred demonstrations, and explicit satisfaction metrics for motion, skill, and user-profile preferences.
papers.task: Evaluate zero-shot, learned, generalized, composed, and conflicting preferences separately from task completion.
papers.novelty: Separates robotic task success from how a user wants the task performed with reusable, automatically scored preference variables.
papers.project_relevance: Adds Preference, SatisfactionMetric, Conflict, Composition, UserProfile, and personalized manipulation evaluation fields.

papers.title: Orbia: Do Generated Videos Form a Consistent 3D World?
papers.data: 720 indoor/outdoor exploration cases, six exploration-and-revisit protocols, and evaluations of 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models.
papers.method: Measures input preservation, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency using registered RGB-D anchors, revisit comparisons, cross-view geometry, scale, and held-out rendering.
papers.task: Benchmark whether interactive video generators preserve one consistent 3D world across exploration and revisits.
papers.novelty: Systematically tests newly generated regions for persistence as well as cross-view geometric agreement and minute-long return consistency.
papers.project_relevance: Direct validator for Persistence, Revisit, InputPreservation, CrossViewDepth, RegionalScale, and held-out reconstruction.

papers.title: ForceBench: Benchmarking Force Integration for Robotic Manipulation
papers.data: Eight tasks, 1,600 synchronized demonstrations, six-axis wrist force, seven integration designs, and five real-world tasks.
papers.method: Controls backbone, demonstrations, task criteria, and evaluation protocol to isolate visual-force fusion design choices.
papers.task: Benchmark how force observations should be integrated into VLA policies for physical-property, resistance, and assembly tasks.
papers.novelty: Provides a unified protocol that separates force-fusion architecture effects from task and control differences.
papers.project_relevance: Adds ForceObservation, FusionDesign, Resistance, ContactAssembly, and sim/real force-integration evaluation fields.

papers.title: TacClaw-Infinity: A Large-Scale Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.data: Over 10,000 hours, one million episodes, and one billion frames across more than 1,000 tasks, with synchronized vision, fingertip tactile, language, and actions.
papers.method: A tactile UMI-style handheld interface plus distributed collection, trajectory reconstruction, embodiment-aware filtering, quality control, and structured contact/spatial annotation.
papers.task: Scale contact-rich VTLA demonstrations and test cross-embodiment dexterous transfer.
papers.novelty: Combines unprecedented VTLA scale with contact segmentation, subtasks, spatial grounding, and collection independent of the target robot.
papers.project_relevance: Direct source for VisionTactileLanguageAction, ContactSegment, QualityFilter, EmbodimentMap, and large-scale manipulation data schemas.

papers.title: Active Generative Simulation: Meta-Learning What to Simulate for Sim-and-Real Policy Co-Training
papers.data: Simulation parameter spaces, limited real demonstrations, generated skill/object-receptacle combinations, and real manipulation evaluations.
papers.method: MetaGenSim trains a rater by meta-gradients to select simulator generation distributions that maximize downstream real-policy performance.
papers.task: Optimize what simulation data to generate for sim-and-real co-training.
papers.novelty: Turns simulator data generation into a downstream-performance optimization problem rather than uniform sampling or manual alignment.
papers.project_relevance: Useful for GeneratorDistribution, UtilityRater, SimRealAlignment, SkillStitching, and data-curriculum infrastructure.

papers.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
papers.data: Twelve VLAs on SimplerEnv plus WAM, real-robot and frozen-backbone analyses.
papers.method: Training-free neighborhood-overlap metric compares sensory representation geometry with end-effector trajectory geometry.
papers.task: Offline screening and diagnosis of embodied policies and candidate backbones.
papers.novelty: Introduces sensorimotor alignment as an inexpensive representation-level proxy for closed-loop success.
papers.project_relevance: A direct pre-rollout validator for prioritizing VLA/WAM baselines and backbone candidates.

papers.title: PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models
papers.data: IntPhys2 plus new interval annotations for solidity, permanence, immutability and continuity.
papers.method: History-conditioned expected events are aligned with overlapping observed video windows to localize violations.
papers.task: Temporal localization and explanation of physical-consistency failures in generated video.
papers.novelty: Moves beyond scalar plausibility to time-localized, interpretable physical violations and releases annotations/code.
papers.project_relevance: A direct validator for generated world-model rollouts and reconstruction trajectories.

papers.title: RoboJudge: Multimodal Language Models as Judges for Embodied Video Generation
papers.data: 800 benchmark videos from 8 corpora/10 generators and 12,351 training videos with human-verified scores.
papers.method: Benchmark plus a 9B MLLM judge trained with supervised learning and reinforcement learning.
papers.task: Judge physical adherence and instruction alignment of generated embodied videos.
papers.novelty: Systematically validates judge-human agreement for embodied rollouts and releases a specialized training/evaluation bundle.
papers.project_relevance: A direct automated evaluator for candidate embodied-video/world-model rollouts.
